Message:
KVM: Introduce KVM_MEMORY_ENCRYPT_OP ioctl

If the hardware supports memory encryption then the
KVM_MEMORY_ENCRYPT_OP ioctl can be used by qemu to issue a platform
specific memory encryption commands.
